spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Offered with fire, burnt as an oblation.
2 Called, invoked.
n. (-तं)
Oblation.
E.
हु to sacrifice, or ह्वे to call, क्त aff.

m. (-तः-ता-तं)
Called, summoned, invited.
E.
ह्वे to call, क्त aff.

f. (-या)
The wife of AGNI or fire.
E.
हुतभुज् AGNI, and प्रिया the wife.

m. (-भुक्)
AGNI or fire.
E.
हुत an oblation, भुज to eat, क्विप् aff.

m. (-हः)
AGNI or fire.
E.
हुत an oblation, and वह who carries.

m. (-मः)
A Brahman who has offered an oblation.
n. (-मं)
An oblation.
E.
हुत, and होम sacrifice.

m. (-ग्निः)
Fire with which oblation is made.
E.
हुत, and अग्नि fire.

m. (-शः)
Fire or its deity AGNI.
E.
हुत an oblation, and अश who eats.

m. (-नः)
1 Fire or its deity.
2 ŚIVA.
E.
हुत burnt-offering, and अशन food.

Calling to in defiance, challenging.
E.
ह्वेञ् to call, aff. क्तिच्.

ind.
Having offered in oblation.
E.
हु to offer, क्त्वा aff.
